tenderSchedule.title: TENDERS FOR PROVIDING MANPOWER TO KSAMB FROM THE OUTSOURCING AGENCY
tenderSchedule.description: TENDERS FOR PROVIDING MANPOWER TO KSAMB FROM THE OUTSOURCING AGENCY
tenderSchedule.locationName: Chief General Manager KSAMB Office Bangalore

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions ass per bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Minimum five years FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26 experience in deploying Manpower personnel to State Government Departments, State Government Undertakings. Certificates by competent authorities should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal in support of meeting this requirement of minimum 150 employees per Financial Year

The tenders should have executed at least two service contracts copy of contract or certificate from concerned organization/institute may be furnished and uploaded during the last three years i.e.2023-24 to 2025-26., to similar organizations as detailed in (a) above Certificates by competent authorities should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal in support of meeting this requirement
The tenderer should comply with the minimum wages as per the zones specified by Department of Labour
Declaration for Non-black listing of the firm anywhere in India
Tenderer has to submit the Returns of ESI, PF and GST / Service Tax, Professional Tax in the recent past three years without fail
Scanned Copy of the latest GST clearance certificate to be uploaded
The tenderer has to submit Latest valid Form-C issued by the labor department with at least 05 times of the tender manpower requirement as the staff working in his/her organization
The tenderer has to submit Last Three years paid receipts of labour welfare fund paid to the welfare commissioner Karnataka labour welfare board (FORM D) to be submitted
The Tenderer must have been ISO 9001-2015 certified for providing Manpower services
The Tenderer should have paid ESI & EPF Payment within the Stipulated Due time. Tenderer should provide ESI & EPF Payment Challans for the recent 05 FY (2021-22 to 2025-26)
Valid Police verification certificate issued by Private Security Agency Licensing Portal, PSARA

Disbursed Annual salary payments of not less than Rs.2.0crore to various categories of personnel in other offices as stated in (a) above in one or more contracts in any one of the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26). This should be Certified by a Chartered Accountant and the certificate should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal
The Tenderer must have made profit during the past 3 Financial Years. Supporting financial of the organization should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal
Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account of the Tenderer for the three years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) duly certified by a Chartered Accountant
Annual Turnover Statement for the three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) should not be under Rs.5.0 crore and should be duly certified by Chartered Accountant
